briefdescription.para: Compress size bytes at data with LZ4 (safe version with parameter validation).

detaileddescription.para: Lz4 compress safe.

data
Pointer to input bytes (must not be nullptr unless size==0).
size
Number of bytes to compress (must not exceed MAX_INPUT_SIZE).
acceleration
LZ4 acceleration factor (1-1000; values outside range are auto-clamped).
Ok(compressed_bytes) on success; Err on failure or parameter validation failure.
Parameter Validation: Acceleration parameter is silently clamped to valid range [1-1000]. Invalid values are logged as WARN but do not prevent compression.
Max Input: Input size is validated against MAX_INPUT_SIZE to prevent DoS allocation.
Output Bounds: Output size is checked against MAX_COMPRESSION_RATIO to detect anomalies.
Block-Size Overflow: LZ4 block size limits are validated to prevent overflow (Phase 2.4b).
Thread-Safe: Safe for concurrent calls from multiple threads.
Acceleration: Higher acceleration = faster compression + lower compression ratio.
@error COMPRESSION_FAILED LZ4 compression failed (insufficient memory or state error). @error COMPRESSION_INPUT_INVALID Input size exceeds limit or block-size would overflow. @error CODEC_NOT_SUPPORTED LZ4 library not available (THEMIS_HAS_LZ4 not defined).

Phase 2.4b Hardening: Output buffer sizing, block-size overflow check, unavailable handling.
data
Input parameter.
size
Input parameter.
acceleration
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: Ok(), THEMIS_WARN(), fmt::format(), LZ4_compressBound(), resize(), LZ4_compress_fast(), data(), std::string().

briefdescription.para: Decompress an LZ4-compressed block with validation.

detaileddescription.para: Lz4 decompress safe.

compressed
Compressed bytes produced by lz4_compress*.
original_size
Exact size of the original uncompressed data (required by the LZ4 block format; must be stored alongside the compressed payload by the caller).
Ok(decompressed_bytes) on success; Err on failure or unsupported.
Size Validation: original_size is validated against MAX_DECOMPRESSED_SIZE and MAX_COMPRESSION_RATIO to prevent decompression bombs.
Corrupt Input: Malformed or truncated compressed data returns error, not silent failure.
Block-Size Validation: Checks that decompressed output fits within size limits.
Unavailable Handling: Returns error if THEMIS_HAS_LZ4 not defined (Phase 2.4b).
@error DECOMPRESSION_FAILED LZ4 decompression failed (invalid or corrupt input). @error COMPRESSION_BOMB_DETECTED original_size exceeds MAX_DECOMPRESSED_SIZE. @error COMPRESSION_RATIO_EXCEEDED Ratio original_size/compressed.size() exceeds MAX_COMPRESSION_RATIO. @error CODEC_NOT_SUPPORTED LZ4 library not available (THEMIS_HAS_LZ4 not defined).

Phase 2.4b Hardening: Output buffer validation, block-size checks, unavailable library fallback.

Input parameter.
original_size
Input parameter.
Return value.
